summary: Phyllotaxis is a Raspberry Pi/ESP32 controller that drives an LED strip to display a phyllotaxis pattern reacting to live audio. It runs locally using GPIO and an optional Web UI, without needing any external API keys. Makers looking for a visually striking, real‑time audio visualisation on custom hardware would reach for this tool. The project shines in speed—its benchmark runs 2.2× faster than a comparable Python implementation—but its documentation and integration support are sparse, and automated tests show limited functional coverage.
